ARQ（自动重传请求）把数据分块发送，收方校验出错即请求重发；自适应速率会随信道: ARQ (automatic repeat request) sends data in blocks and the receiver asks for retransmission when the check fails; the adaptive rate rises or falls with channel quality, so a weak path still connects while a good path speeds up.
HF 上通常在各波段的数据 / 自动子段内工作（避开 CW 与话音段，也避开 F: On HF it usually works within the data / automatic sub-bands of each band (avoiding the CW and voice segments, and crowded spots such as FT8).
HF 最强邮件调制：多音自适应速率 + ARQ 重传，把时域压缩做到硬件里；需: The strongest HF mail modem: multi-tone adaptive rates with ARQ retransmission, compression built into hardware; needs an SCS modem.
PACTOR 早期版本，被 PACTOR 4 向下兼容；部分网关仍在使用。: Earlier PACTOR versions, backwards compatible with PACTOR 4; some gateways still use them.
Radio Message Server，接收无线电信号并转发邮件的网关台站。: Radio Message Server: the gateway station that receives radio signals and forwards mail.
VARA / ARDOP 等软件调制解调，把数据编码成音频经电台收发。: Software modems such as VARA / ARDOP encode data as audio to be sent and received through the radio.
VHF / UHF 高速数据，约 9.6 kbps 量级。: High-speed VHF/UHF data, on the order of 9.6 kbps.
VHF/UHF 走本地 RMS 网关的固定频点，与 APRS 频率不同，不要混用: On VHF/UHF it uses the fixed frequency of the local RMS gateway, which differs from the APRS frequency — do not mix them up.
Winlink 没有全球单一呼叫频率，应按目标 RMS 网关公布的频点选频（软件: Winlink has no single worldwide calling frequency; pick the frequency published for the target RMS gateway (the software's built-in gateway list gives available frequencies by band and time).
Winlink 需要「电台 + 电脑声卡（或 TNC）+ Winlink Exp: Winlink requires "radio + computer sound card (or TNC) + Winlink Express client".
先听再叫：确认频点空闲且能收到网关信标再发起连接。: Listen before calling: confirm the frequency is clear and that you can hear the gateway's beacon before connecting.
先找到能通联的 RMS 网关频率与时间表，再尝试连接。: First find the frequency and schedule of an RMS gateway you can reach, then attempt the connection.
全球业余无线电邮件系统，通过 HF / VHF 把邮件经 RMS 网关接入互联网: A worldwide amateur radio mail system that carries mail over HF / VHF through RMS gateways onto the Internet.
发送端加入冗余，收端可自行纠错而无需重传，适合单向广播；实际系统常把 ARQ 与: The sender adds redundancy so the receiver can correct errors itself without retransmission, suiting one-way broadcasts; real systems often combine ARQ with FEC.
开源 ARQ 调制，兼容 Winlink 与其它邮件系统。: Open-source ARQ modem, compatible with Winlink and other mail systems.
灾害时手机与互联网中断，可用 Winlink 通过 HF 远程收发邮件报平安。: When mobile phones and the Internet are cut off in a disaster, Winlink over HF can send and receive mail to report that you are safe.
硬件 TNC 调制解调协议，HF 邮件传输能力强，但需专用设备。: A hardware TNC modem protocol with strong HF mail throughput, but requiring dedicated equipment.
自适应速率 ARQ，Winlink 最常用的 HF 调制。: Adaptive-rate ARQ, the most common HF modem for Winlink.
部分本地 RMS 以 VHF/UHF 分组（Packet）或 Telnet 方式: Some local RMS gateways are reachable via VHF/UHF packet or Telnet, for local or emergency use.
配合 EmComm 演练，提前注册 Winlink 账户并熟悉客户端。: Alongside EmComm drills, register a Winlink account and get to know the client in advance.
